q1_issues.issue: The subject of 'requires' is given Holder, but Holder is possession-only (own/have/lack) and the instruction set states that only possession and stative psych/perception move a transitive subject off Agent — a stative transitive ('the tank holds forty litres') still takes Agent.

q2_gaps: intensional/non-specific object of a necessity verb: 'a countersignature' need not exist, yet the indefinite-argument rule mints a top-level existential witness that asserts one does
notes: The event form is correct — the relational-generic section explicitly excludes indefinite singulars ('a winch needs an annual inspection'), so no kind-level (Require permit countersignature) is wanted, and the bare present correctly gets no status atom. Only the subject role head is wrong.
